name: aloud-notes-ppt
description: Teaching notes from a PowerPoint deck: one paragraph per slide that covers every slide point, with a dark-red significance sentence after each important point and one 7 to 8 line summary per run of derivation slides (what is calculated, how, why it matters). Plain statements, consequences and equation readings, no stage directions or questions. Copies and renders the deck (PowerPoint COM, never Quit), parallel writer brief, two-column Latin Modern XeLaTeX PDF (13 pt body, 15 pt title, 1 cm margins, writing gaps, optional slide range) with checks for coverage length, mathematics block line counts, control characters, old font commands, markup, glyphs, overfull lines and page limits. Skills: `aloud-notes-ppt`.
